title: The Abydos boats are the remnants of ancient Egyptian ceremonial wooden boats found in brick-lined boat graves, in Abydos, with their prows pointed towards the Nile. They were probably made for the afterlife journeys of the Pharaoh Hor-Aha (c. 3085 BCE) or Pharaoh Djer (c. 3000 BCE) [900×1072]
